name: Sheet Metal Calculators
description: A library of shop calculators (flat length / bend allowance and more) behind a picker.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: None needed - just open it. Have your numbers ready (thickness, radius, material, and so on).
how_it_works: Pick a calculator from the left list; the form on the right rebuilds for it.
Enter the inputs and the result updates as you type; some field labels and rows change based on your other choices.
Calculators included: Flat Length, Bend Deduction, and Material Weight (more get added over time).
output: The calculated result (or a small table of results) shown live - nothing is saved to a file.
